title: Shrinks Too Much
text:
Shrinks Too Much. The width of the flat sheet shrinks a lot, even after just the first wash. I washed using cold water, gentle cycle, and in a very large mesh laundry bag designed to use when washing sheets in the washing machine. I put it in the dryer on very low heat, and did not over-dry, and removed immediately.

The sheets are soft and not too thick. Perhaps if they made the sheet larger and then pre-shrink it, that might be better.
